findings.highlight: I'm working the evening shift so that I can match your arrival
findings.evidenceJa: わたしに合わせるよう遅番にしろって言ったから、夜は閉店までいると思います
findings.explanation: Koharu tells the person on the phone that she arranged for Haruki's shift to be made a late one matching hers, so he should remain until closing. The English makes Koharu herself take an evening shift to match the listener's arrival, reversing whose schedule she manipulated and concealing the setup.
findings.japanese:
「わたしに合わせるよう遅番にしろって言ったから、
夜は閉店までいると思います」
findings.todokanai: "I'm working the evening shift so that I can match your arrival, so I intend to stay until the closing hours tonight."

findings.highlight: "My family's planning to have a Christmas party on the 25th. My mom's gonna make fried chicken in the morning, and we're all having flavored champagne as usual."
findings.evidenceJa:
『うち、クリスマスパーティは２５日なの。
朝からお母さんと一緒にチキン焼いて、
相変わらずジュースのシャンペンで乾杯して』
findings.explanation: Setsuna and her mother bake or roast the chicken together and toast with nonalcoholic champagne-like juice; the English makes her mother fry it alone and calls the drink flavored champagne.
findings.japanese:
『うち、クリスマスパーティは２５日なの。
朝からお母さんと一緒にチキン焼いて、
相変わらずジュースのシャンペンで乾杯して』
findings.todokanai: "My family's planning to have a Christmas party on the 25th. My mom's gonna make fried chicken in the morning, and we're all having flavored champagne as usual."

findings.highlight: "Mom has been telling Takahiro for a while now that it's about time he brought home his girlfriend, but it doesn't seem like that'll be happening this year."
findings.evidenceJa:
『お母さんは孝宏に
そろそろ彼女連れてきたらって言ってるけど、
どうやら今年もそんな気配はなさそう』
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother urges Takahiro to bring a girlfriend sometime, without presupposing one exists; the English says 'his girlfriend.'
findings.japanese:
『お母さんは孝宏に
そろそろ彼女連れてきたらって言ってるけど、
どうやら今年もそんな気配はなさそう』
findings.todokanai: "Mom has been telling Takahiro for a while now that it's about time he brought home his girlfriend, but it doesn't seem like that'll be happening this year."

findings.highlight: it's not like Setsuna to be compromising
findings.evidenceJa: 駆け引きのできるような彼女じゃない
findings.explanation: Haruki concludes that Setsuna is incapable of strategic maneuvering or romantic game-playing, so the opening in her argument is probably innocent. The English says she is not compromising, nearly the opposite trait: refusal to compromise rather than inability to scheme.
findings.japanese:
…気づいてないんだろうなぁ。
駆け引きのできるような彼女じゃないしな。
findings.todokanai: …She probably isn't aware of it. After all, it's not like Setsuna to be compromising.

findings.highlight: When a lump of good intentions like her is mad at me
findings.evidenceJa: そんな善意の塊に腹を立ててもしょうがない
findings.explanation: Haruki says there is no point in his getting angry at someone who is nothing but good intentions. The English makes Koharu the one angry at him, reversing whose anger he is reasoning away.
findings.japanese:
…けど、何しろ裏も下心も他意もまるっきりないから、
そんな善意の塊に腹を立ててもしょうがないんだよな。
findings.todokanai: But it's not like she has any ulterior motive. When a lump of good intentions like her is mad at me, there's not much I can do about it.

findings.highlight: I'm shocked by how perfectly synced their sighs were just now.
findings.evidenceJa:
こういう時の呆れたような視線だけ、
息ぴったりでシンクロしやがって。
findings.explanation: Takeya and Io synchronize their exasperated looks, translated as synchronized sighs.
findings.japanese:
こういう時の呆れたような視線だけ、
息ぴったりでシンクロしやがって。
findings.todokanai: I'm shocked by how perfectly synced their sighs were just now.

findings.highlight: Glancing inside my wallet, I bid farewell to the thousand yen bills that I'd been saving for situations like these.
findings.evidenceJa:
財布を覗くと、
こういう時に限って千円札が潤沢なのがやるせない。
findings.explanation: Haruki is frustrated that his wallet happens to be flush with thousand-yen notes at this moment; the English says he had saved them for situations like this.
findings.japanese:
財布を覗くと、
こういう時に限って千円札が潤沢なのがやるせない。
findings.todokanai: Glancing inside my wallet, I bid farewell to the thousand yen bills that I'd been saving for situations like these.

findings.highlight: only going to be aired once and only on a single day
findings.evidenceJa: １日１回しか上映しないのか
findings.explanation: Haruki asks why the supposedly top film is screened only once per day. The English says it will be shown only once on a single day, changing the revival's ongoing daily schedule into a one-off event.
findings.japanese:
「なんだよ、１日１回しか上映しないのか。
今年の邦画ナンバーワンじゃなかったのかよ」
findings.todokanai: "Wait, what? So this is only going to be aired once and only on a single day? It's the number one Japanese film of the year, is it not?"

findings.highlight: Not only did she buy the magazine that published my first article, she also held a celebration for its release, and always finds plenty of work for me to do, so isn't it normal to pay her back?
findings.evidenceJa:
俺の初仕事の載った雑誌を買ってくれたお礼とか、
打ち上げに連れて行ってくれたお礼とか、
今まで仕事を叩き込んでくれたお礼とか。
findings.explanation: Mari drilled professional work into Haruki, rendered as finding plenty of work for him.
findings.japanese:
俺の初仕事の載った雑誌を買ってくれたお礼とか、
打ち上げに連れて行ってくれたお礼とか、
今まで仕事を叩き込んでくれたお礼とか。
findings.todokanai: Not only did she buy the magazine that published my first article, she also held a celebration for its release, and always finds plenty of work for me to do, so isn't it normal to pay her back?

findings.highlight: Like jumping into a freshwater spri… no, I initially planned to leap into Arumi's waters
findings.evidenceJa: 清水の舞台…じゃなくて、有海の海に飛び込んだつもりで
findings.explanation: Takeya begins the proverb about taking the plunge from Kiyomizu's stage, then comically corrects it to diving into Arumi's sea to suit the bay setting. The English misreads 清水 as fresh water, changes the self-correction into a prior plan, and leaves both the proverb and the proper-name pun incoherent.
findings.japanese:
「畜生わかったよ！　清水の舞台…じゃなくて、
有海の海に飛び込んだつもりで、
思い切って３万６千円でＯＫ！」
findings.todokanai: "Damn it… fine! Like jumping into a freshwater spri… no, I initially planned to leap into Arumi's waters, but I'm okay with selling it to you for 36,000 yen!"

findings.highlight: one of those restaurants that adds things to your bill without you being aware of it
findings.evidenceJa: まるで注文の多い料理店のように、徐々に俺を食い物にしていった
findings.explanation: Haruki explicitly invokes Miyazawa's The Restaurant of Many Orders: Takeya's tickets impose one condition after another until they figuratively devour him, as the restaurant intends to devour its guests. The English invents a restaurant billing scam and erases the named literary mechanism.
findings.japanese:
武也が売りつけた『映画のチケット』は、
まるで注文の多い料理店のように、
徐々に俺を食い物にしていった。
findings.todokanai: Takeya's movie ticket deal makes me feel like I was just in one of those restaurants that adds things to your bill without you being aware of it, gradually prying your money away.

findings.highlight: After being viciously caught off guard
findings.evidenceJa: 悪質なマルチに引っかかった後の虚無感
findings.explanation: Haruki compares the spreading financial trap to the emptiness after being taken in by a malicious multilevel-marketing or pyramid scheme. The English reduces this explicit scam analogy to being caught off guard, losing the escalation from literary restaurant to predatory sales scheme.
findings.japanese:
悪質なマルチに引っかかった後の虚無感が、
じわじわと俺の全身を支配していく。
findings.todokanai: After being viciously caught off guard, I feel a sense of emptiness slowly taking over my entire body.

findings.highlight: I'll never fall for such a thing again
findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ迂闊に生返事だけはしないぞと誓いつつ
findings.explanation: Haruki vows that this time he will not carelessly give another vague, halfhearted assent—the behavior that lets others maneuver him into obligations. The English makes him vow not to fall for a scam again, changing a recurring interpersonal habit into generic gullibility.
findings.japanese:
それでも、
今度こそ迂闊に生返事だけはしないぞと誓いつつ、
ぐったりと、人の減ってきた店内を眺める。
findings.todokanai: Thus, as I swear to myself that I'll never fall for such a thing again, still staggering, I realize that the number of customers in the restaurant has decreased.

findings.highlight: Well, if that's the case, then we're no different.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなの、お互いの定番過ぎて絞り込めないだろ
findings.explanation: Haruki asks which previous occasion Koharu means by his not being honest, then jokes that this is such a standard pattern between them that he cannot narrow it down. The English says only that the two are no different, deleting the frequency joke and his attempt to identify the incident.
findings.japanese:
前に素直じゃなかったのはいつのことだよ？
…そんなの、お互いの定番過ぎて絞り込めないだろ。
findings.todokanai: Was I not honest before? …Well, if that's the case, then we're no different.

findings.highlight: She also really insisted that I should absolutely not tell anyone.
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対に押し込めって、強く言い聞かせておいたよ
findings.explanation: Io says she extracted the meeting date from Setsuna and then firmly told Setsuna to press the opportunity through at all costs. The English makes Setsuna instruct Io not to tell anyone, reversing both speaker and content and contradicting Io's active coordination of the plan.
findings.japanese:
「さっき、何とか雪菜に吐かせた。
絶対に押し込めって、強く言い聞かせておいたよ」
findings.todokanai: "I got it out of Setsuna a little while ago, somehow. She also really insisted that I should absolutely not tell anyone."

findings.highlight: "Still, there's just no way. This is Haruki we're talking about. How could that dense brick make girls do so much for him…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「けど、まさか。
相手は春希だぞ？
あの堅物にそこまでズブズブにハマる女の子が…」
findings.explanation: Takeya doubts that a girl could fall so hopelessly deeply for a stiff man like Haruki; the English asks how Haruki could make girls do so much for him.
findings.japanese:
「けど、まさか。
相手は春希だぞ？
あの堅物にそこまでズブズブにハマる女の子が…」
findings.todokanai: "Still, there's just no way. This is Haruki we're talking about. How could that dense brick make girls do so much for him…"

findings.highlight: My hands are on my knees, I'm deeply bending forward, and I'm panting heavily.
findings.evidenceJa:
膝に手を当てて、がっくりと俯き、
盛大にため息をつく。
findings.explanation: Haruki bends down and releases a huge sigh, translated as panting heavily.
findings.japanese:
膝に手を当てて、がっくりと俯き、
盛大にため息をつく。
findings.todokanai: My hands are on my knees, I'm deeply bending forward, and I'm panting heavily.

findings.highlight: I sprinted into the train when it arrived and the seat kept making creaking sounds due to my impatient fidgeting. Just waiting for ten minutes felt like several hours.
findings.evidenceJa:
ようやく来た電車に飛び乗り、
ガラガラの座席にイライラしながら腰掛け、
ほんの１０分を数時間のように感じ。
findings.explanation: Haruki irritably sits among nearly empty seats; the English invents a creaking seat caused by fidgeting.
findings.japanese:
ようやく来た電車に飛び乗り、
ガラガラの座席にイライラしながら腰掛け、
ほんの１０分を数時間のように感じ。
findings.todokanai: I sprinted into the train when it arrived and the seat kept making creaking sounds due to my impatient fidgeting. Just waiting for ten minutes felt like several hours.

findings.highlight: I hadn't even thought of my cell phone until now
findings.evidenceJa: さっきから、何度も無視され続けてる携帯を、最後の望みとばかりにリダイヤルする
findings.explanation: Haruki has already called repeatedly and been ignored; he redials yet again as his last hope. The English says the phone had not occurred to him until now, erasing the repeated unanswered attempts that establish Koharu's deliberate silence.
findings.japanese:
さっきから、何度も無視され続けてる携帯を、
最後の望みとばかりにリダイヤルする。
findings.todokanai: I hadn't even thought of my cell phone until now, as it's my final hope. I press the redial button.

findings.highlight: Sugiura is trying her best to explain it in a very simple and logical manner, but it turns into a mystery
findings.evidenceJa: いつも、筋が通ってるかは別として、相手にわかりやすく論理的に話そうとする杉浦の、まるっきり謎かけみたいな感情的な吐露
findings.explanation: The point is a contrast: Koharu normally tries to speak logically and plainly, whether or not her logic is sound, but this particular emotional outpouring is entirely like a riddle. The English says she is trying to explain this outpouring logically now and somehow it turns mysterious, losing the marked departure from her normal voice.
findings.japanese:
いつも、筋が通ってるかは別として、
相手にわかりやすく論理的に話そうとする杉浦の、
まるっきり謎かけみたいな感情的な吐露。
findings.todokanai: Ignoring whether or not it made sense, Sugiura is trying her best to explain it in a very simple and logical manner, but it turns into a mystery when she expresses her feelings.

findings.highlight: For a while, I walked with my head hung low since I couldn't find my way around Minegaya anyway.
findings.evidenceJa:
しばらく、ずっと俯いて歩いてたから、
ここが峰ヶ谷のどの辺りなのかもよくわからない。
findings.explanation: Haruki does not know where he is because he walked looking down; the English says he looked down because he could not navigate Minegaya.
findings.japanese:
しばらく、ずっと俯いて歩いてたから、
ここが峰ヶ谷のどの辺りなのかもよくわからない。
findings.todokanai: For a while, I walked with my head hung low since I couldn't find my way around Minegaya anyway.

findings.highlight: "You do know that the last train might have already left, right?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「終電、なくなってること知ってますよね？」
findings.explanation: Koharu knows the last train is already gone; the English says it might have left.
findings.japanese: 「終電、なくなってること知ってますよね？」
findings.todokanai: "You do know that the last train might have already left, right?"

findings.highlight: It's as if we're walking on a curved plank that's barely the width of a foot, like we're always trying to get back to where we began…
findings.evidenceJa:
足の幅ほどしかない平均台の上を蛇行してるみたいに、
すぐに振り出しに戻ってしまいそうな…
findings.explanation: The pair weave along a balance beam only a foot wide and may return to the starting point; the English invents a curved plank and makes returning sound intentional.
findings.japanese:
足の幅ほどしかない平均台の上を蛇行してるみたいに、
すぐに振り出しに戻ってしまいそうな…
findings.todokanai: It's as if we're walking on a curved plank that's barely the width of a foot, like we're always trying to get back to where we began…

findings.highlight: The wound on Setsuna's chest is still open and has yet to be healed.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の裸の胸に刻まれた、まだ塞がらずに化膿していたその傷
findings.explanation: Haruki remembers the wound carved into Setsuna's bare chest, still unclosed and suppurating. The English omits both the naked visual that makes the memory intimate and the infection that makes it graphic, then redundantly says open and unhealed instead of conveying its severity.
findings.japanese:
雪菜の裸の胸に刻まれた、
まだ塞がらずに化膿していたその傷を。
findings.todokanai: The wound on Setsuna's chest is still open and has yet to be healed.

findings.highlight: "Besides, after having dinner near the sea, it'll be very late, so what am I even saying…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「それに有海で夕食だと帰り遅くなるし、
何言ってんだろうな、俺」
findings.explanation: Dinner in the proper-name location Arumi becomes dinner 'near the sea.'
findings.japanese:
「それに有海で夕食だと帰り遅くなるし、
何言ってんだろうな、俺」
findings.todokanai: "Besides, after having dinner near the sea, it'll be very late, so what am I even saying…"
